research_goal: Test whether P50 held-out source texts leak into the proposed training corpus through record duplication, text duplication, or high-coverage near duplicates without moving the source packet or altering task authority.

tiers.question: Are canonical token bytes reproducible?
tiers.method: Stream and hash exact 100M/2M token binaries; assert ids <32768 and original tokenizer SHA

tiers.question: Do exact selected record hashes overlap across tokenizer/train/dev?
tiers.method: Replay pinned upstream permutation, generate per-role sorted SHA256 record-hash membership lists; independently intersect sets; match canonical aggregate receipts and token SHA

tiers.question: Do different record IDs contain identical normalized text?
tiers.method: Replay same selected rows; hash normalized text independent of record ID and URL; compare all three role sets

tiers.question: Are frozen PIA sources exact or high-containment fragments of selected train/dev text?
tiers.method: Load exactly the existing 24 PIA source texts, never hidden references; replay selected FineWeb2 documents and compare normalized text and character-shingle containment. Same frozen items, no retuning.

tiers.question: Does semantic paraphrase leakage persist outside lexical near-duplicate detection?
tiers.method: Report lexical detector false-negative ceiling as unknown; a semantic screen, if added, must be independently prospective and may not use PIA labels or outcome-based threshold tuning.

tiers.question: Are P47/P48/P49 protected surfaces separately honored?
tiers.method: Load exact available prior-phase source hashes and split receipts; run additional independent exclusion. P50-only PIA hash matches do not cover all historical holdouts.

char_containment_preseal.preprocessing: Whitespace-only fold for matching, preserve Unicode code points, no NFKC/no semantic rewriting. This fold is audit-only and does not mutate train tokens.
char_containment_preseal.near_duplicate_rule: For protected source after whitespace-folding, if Unicode codepoint length >= 15 use unique character 9-grams; if length 5-14 use unique character 5-grams; if length <5 require exact match and manual review. Flag containment ≥0.80.
char_containment_preseal.short_source_rule: Never silently declare short-string non-match as secure.
char_containment_preseal.coverage_metric: Report maximum source-in-document containment for each of 24 frozen PIA sources, exact-hit count and candidate near-dup hit count by source family, and preserved source IDs (no raw text).
char_containment_preseal.action_on_hit: HOLD for review; do not automatically modify canonical v1 token stream or remove inconvenient PIA sources.
char_containment_preseal.limits: High containment can be chance/common formula; no hit does not prove absence of paraphrase or translated copies.

independence_requirements.hash_sets: Sorted role-specific record-hash AND normalized-text-hash lists must be read by an independent validator; mere zero counters generated by the sampler do not prove disjointness.
independence_requirements.receipts: Counts, SHA256 of lists, exact tokenizer/source revision, selected document counts, and collision witnesses by opaque hash only
independence_requirements.post_hit_policy: New prospective v2 data-slice design or explicit narrower inference; NEVER quietly replace canonical train.u16le and call it the same v1 experiment.
